items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 6.3.2 at source lines 404-408: if f x = g x for every x : A then f = g in A -> B, and this is proved with the function extensionality axiom suspended. The proof is a real construction rather than a citation: for each x : A it builds ptil_x : I -> B by interval recursion, sending the path constructor seg to the given path p x (source lines 411-417), and then applies recursion a second time at the higher type I -> (A -> B) to obtain q (source lines 418-419). Both endpoint identifications at lines 420-421 rest only on the recursion computation rules, and the conclusion is the path ap q (seg) in the function type (line 422): nothing in the statement records that the interval's path constructor, and not any extensionality axiom, is what produces the function-level equality.
